facts.fact: ANSUTEN, the national universal service agency, presented on 22 July 2025 a feasibility study (with SFM Technologies, since 2023) mapping white zones and aiming at coverage of 90% of the rural population by 2030, with an international tender for technical and financial partners to follow.

facts.fact: Guinea's deputy national director of telecommunications said the country, under the Simandou 2040 programme and its digital planning master plan, targets 857 priority rural localities and a one-stop shop for infrastructure sharing to cut operators' costs in uncovered areas.
